The watch learns from you: mark a finding as known, or keep it as a real incident with a note. It also looks at more of your server, and the logs of your containers, plugins and user scripts get rows of their own on the tile. Thanks to @Revan335, whose questions in [#3](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/tollroll/issues/3) started it.

## ✨ Added
- **Is known or Real incident.** Every finding of the watch has two buttons in the Open view and in the status window. Is known takes it as normal, and TollRoll does not report the same again. Real incident keeps it with your note, and for 30 days TollRoll tells you right away when the same thing comes from the same source, even during the quiet hours.
- **Containers with special rights.** A container that runs privileged, on the server's own network or with Docker's socket gets a line in the log, once for each right.
- **Unusual disk traffic.** When a disk reads or writes far more in an hour than it usually does, the log says so. TollRoll learns what is usual from the kernel's counters, so it wakes no disk, and it leaves parity checks and the mover out.
- **Snapshots that vanish.** ZFS or btrfs snapshots that are gone, with no app of your fortress having logged their removal, get a line of their own. TollRoll lists snapshots only on pools that are awake.
- **New jobs in the at queue.** A job TollRoll has not seen before gets a line, once.
- **Logs of containers, plugins and user scripts.** They get rows of their own, Containers, Plugins and User Scripts, and their lines are sorted into errors, warnings and info like the syslog's, with the info lines folded away. TollRoll reads only the end of each log, and a container's log only while the disk Docker lives on is awake.
- **Mute until.** Pick a time, and until then only alerts go out. When it ends, one message sums up what waited.
- **All quiet.** Switch it on, and on a day when nothing happened a short message says so at the time of the daily summary.

## 🎨 Design
- **Open points stand apart.** Points in the Open view and the status window, and the suggestions in the settings, each sit on a surface of their own with a gap between them, and the buttons of a finding are filled.
- **Channels from GlimStone's catalog.** In the window that adds a channel, mail shows SMTP as its second line, a search for Element finds Matrix, and the webhook comes last. Back from a channel's form marks the tile you picked before.
- **GlimStone 4.6.0.** With TowerTorch, quiet buttons in the channel window hover in its accent colour, and open lists keep TowerTorch's plain rows.

## ⚡ Improved
- **The tile opens on the log.** The Everything view is gone, since the Apps view shows the rows and the list at the top of the log picks the apps. A tile that was set to Everything opens on the log.
- **A busy app leaves room for the others.** Every app keeps its newest lines in the log, however much another one writes.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **Icons take the colour of the text around them,** so none turns black on a dark tile.

## 🌐 Translations
- **Every new text in all 26 languages Unraid offers,** and the French texts say tu throughout.
